218815.overview: Navigate through various stages such as the enemy fleet, and an asteroid field. Make good use of the devastating "lock-on" attack that can be deployed to break through the onslaught of the enemy forces.

218867.overview: The second entry in the Hara saga. Haratyler takes the intense action of Haradius Zero and supplies more enemies, levels, and fun! This version not only incorporates MMC3 technology similar to Haradius Zero, but also contains a custom audio board allowing for amazing, enhanced musical tracks.

219627.overview: Play as Michael & stalk Laurie Strode.

220211.overview:
“Hunter (or Hunter On Ice)” is a 2000 NES adaptation of “Ice Hunter (or Hunter: Prince of Ice),” a Commodore 64 video game, credited to Colosoftwares, 1983. Jean-François de Wergifosse is probably the developer for both the C64 and NES versions.

Ice Hunter is a single screen platformer where you play as Thorak (or Hunter) the Inuit, Prince of Ice, who is searching for blocks to make a special igloo. Thorak has found a multi-level cave containing the blocks he needs for the igloo. He must get two blocks, one at a time, to a stream at the bottom of the cave, then stand on them to float down the stream. His main problem is the creatures that move around the screen - a Seal and a Dragon. These have to be avoided or if touched he loses one of four lives. The creatures though can be killed by dropping a block on top of them, or allowing them to fall through the gaps. A bird occasionally appears, and can be killed if its flight path is blocked.

To get the blocks to the bottom of the screen, there are platforms over gaps, and to get a gap Thorak can walk on the platform to remove it then drop blocks through the gap to the level below. Thorak can’t fall through the gaps, but there are pillars that can be climbed up or down. At a certain level in the cave, Thorak can’t get back up, so he has to make sure he has two blocks to move to the stream. A power-pill can be collected, and these stun the creatures, which can then be touched to remove them. Once the blocks are floated away, then it’s off to the next cave, with more creatures. The levels start to scroll slowly to the left and appear again on the right of the screen.

266882.overview:
A full moon creeps across the autumn sky, with harvests in the fields. At first glance everything seems serene, but it's not. The gates of hell have been cast open and demons now roam the Earth.

Some are pitiful, other vengeful. These are the lost souls, the neglected spirits. After death they were forgotten. No tributes were given, so now they wander the Earth to improve their lot, at the expense of yours!!!

It is a Hungry Ghost Night!

Play as the sexy Sydney Wang or as the hulking Robert Gasse. Travel across the island nation, for the duration of Ghost month. Can you survive the night?

417966.overview: Ganondorf, the evil Prince of Darkness, has stolen the Triforce of Power, and has ordered his army of demons and goblins to defend the vault that he is keeping it in. The army is growing by the minute, and this time, it’s not only up to Link alone. He is joined in the fight by Princess Zelda, Links’s bodyguard Impa, and the energetic sorceress Lana. Can Link and his crew retrieve the Triforce back from Ganondorf, or will all of Hyrule fall into eternal darkness?

420607.overview: Hu Lu Jin Gang is a Role-Playing (RPG) game based off the Cabash Brothers cartoon. It was developed and published by Shenzhen Nanjing Technology for the Nintendo NES/Nintendo Famicom and released some time in the early 2000's.

421546.overview:
A simple puzzle game.

Dpad:  Move
A:  Push
B:  Retry

424020.overview: Chaos is spreading across the land once again as the Prince of Darkness arises to conquer the world. To stop him and retrieve the legendary Golden Axe, four heroes step forward to accept the challenge.

424078.overview: This hack replaces all of the guy characters of the game Hot Blooded Tough Guy Kunio, with all female characters. In this game, you play as Kunio's good friend Misako, who must rescue her little sister. She was kidnapped by Riki's girlfriend Kyoko, and the rest of her Hot Blooded Tough Girl gang.

424148.overview: Martial arts legend Huo Yuanjia became the most famous fighter in all of China at the turn of the 20th Century. Huo faced personal tragedy but ultimately fought his way out of darkness and into history, defining the true spirit of martial arts. His self-discovery, and the choices he made, inspired his nation. The son of a great fighter who did not wish for his child to follow in his footsteps, the bullied Huo Yuanjia resolves to teach himself how to fight - and win. Years of training enable him to ace match after match in his home region of Tianjin. But as his fame as a martial arts master grows, so does his pride. After an ill-advised fight leads to another master's death, members of Huo's family are slain in revenge. Grieving and ashamed, Huo wanders the country in shock. Near death, he is rescued by women from an idyllic village, and is offered simple kindness and generosity that help him heal and regain his equilibrium over a period of several years. Huo realizes that the future of martial arts lies in sportsmanship and not brutality, and he rejoins society to apply what he has learned. Returning to Tianjin, Huo takes steps to come to terms with his past and restore his family's name. His evolving, graceful Mizong (Missing) Fist method of fighting brings Huo renewed success, and he forms the progressive Jingwu Sports Federation. Taking note, duplicitous members of the Foreign Chamber of Commerce engineer a Shanghai tournament pitting Huo against four fighters, each representing the major foreign powers in China. Huo commits to the bout and faces off against, respectively, a British boxer, a Spanish swordsman, a Belgian soldier, and a Japanese martial artist. What happened that day in 1910 has never been, and will never be, forgotten in China.

424193.overview: Your uncle has recently purchased a remote mansion in which to work on his exotic scientific experiments in isolation, but it was not as secluded as originally hoped! Upon receiving a letter from him, you join forces with your uncle to help reclaim his spooky lair from restless spirits, lost souls, thirsty vampires and more! Explore the vast setting and discover the secrets hidden in the home, the grounds and beyond while fighting your way through hordes of monsters! If you are lucky, you might just survive... The House In The Cemetery!

424260.overview: Super Speed! Bust the video game speed barrier wide open with Hummer. Blaze by in a blur using the super sonic spin attack. Loop the loop by defying gravity. Plummet down tunnels. Then dash to safety with Hummer's power sneakers. All at a frenzied pace. Super Graphics! Help Hummer escape bubbling molten lava. Swim through turbulent waterfalls. Scale glistening green mountains. And soar past shimmering city lights. There's even a 360 degree rotating maze. You've never seen anything like it. Supper Attitude! Hummer has an attitude that just won't quit. He's flip and funny, yet tough as nails as he fights to free his friends from evil. So just wait. Hummer may be the world's next SUPER hero...

424270.overview: NES pirate game released in Hong Kong as The Hummer. It features the Hummer Team mascot, a horse named Hummer. This game is pretty much a Sonic hack for the NES, with Hummer the Horse as the main character.

424349.overview:
Happy Biqi: World Flghter is a clone of the SNES version of Earthworm Jim 2, made by Waixing in 1996, despite the copyrights presumably being registered in 1997. 

Biqi is a very happy boy, who also just happens to be a friend of the Princess. He would do anything to keep the Princess happy, and keeping the Princess happy is a very daunting task! Help Biqi keep the Princess Happy by rounding up loose chickens, rescuing puppies, protecting her from an evil owl wreaking havoc all over the kingdom, and much more!!! He must also keep the Princess entertained by doing such things as becoming a worm to make it through a watery maze, and traversing an area by filling his head up with helium and floating like a balloon. Will Biqi keep the Princess happy, or will sadness fall over the Kingdom?

424350.overview:
On a cold Halloween night in 1963, six year old Michael Myers brutally murdered his 17-year-old sister, Judith. He was sentenced and locked away for 15 years. But on October 30, 1978, while being transferred for a court date, a 21-year-old Michael Myers steals a car and escapes Smith's Grove. He returns to his quiet hometown of Haddonfield, Illinois, where he looks for his next victims.

This converts the game Friday the 13th into Halloween. Laurie has replaced the counselors, clowns replace the zombies, and Michael Myers replaces Jason. Spacial thanks to Sil3nt_J for the awesome spritework.

424458.overview: City kids of all ages will want to take in the natural beauty and breathe the fresh country air in this fascinating farming simulation game. Harvest Moon gives you the chance to experience first-hand the down-to-earth goodness of life on a farm. Instead of zapping zombies from Mars, your goal is to get by on old-fashioned hard work and dedication. Success in this game is measured by the fruits of your labor, so strap on your suspenders, roll up your shirt sleeves and dig in!

424490.overview: Set in late 19th century Canton this martial arts film depicts the stance taken by the legendary martial arts hero Wong Fei-Hung against foreign forces' plundering of China. When Aunt Yee arrives back from America totally westernised, Wong Fei-Hung assumes the role of her protector. This proves to be difficult when his martial arts school and local militia become involved in fierce battles with foreign and local government. As violence escalates even Aunt Yee has to question her new western ideals, but is it possible to fight guns with Kung Fu?

446770.overview:
"Huang Jin Tai Yang" is a role-playing game for the Famicom. It is a Chinese port of the Game Boy Advance game "Golden Sun." Players follow a protagonist on a quest to find the legendary Golden Sun, navigating through various levels filled with enemies and obstacles.

The gameplay includes turn-based combat, puzzle-solving, and character development. Players explore different environments, collect items, and defeat enemies to progress through the game. There are hidden areas and secrets that players can uncover during their journey.

As players advance, they face different challenges requiring strategic use of their abilities and collected items. The objective is to navigate through all the levels, overcome challenges, and discover the secrets of the Golden Sun.

455467.overview:
This is a complete “full game” hack of the Legend of Zelda, including:

    -Title/Intro/Outro/Credits
    -Overworld
    -Dungeons (every dungeon even has a unique theme)
    -All graphics
    -All music
    -Many sound effects

Some things to know:

    -The story is not Zelda universe-related at all.
    -This should work on any hardware or emulator that runs vanilla LoZ.
    -This is intended to be difficult. Not crazy hard, but challenging.
    -There are a handful of in-game mechanics new/different from vanilla LoZ.
    -The up+a sequence, saving, retrying, continuing work as normal.
    -Block-clipping and screen-wrapping have been patched out.

This hack is very large and is not intended to be a quick play. It drastically transforms LoZ into what amounts to be a completely new game, using an enhanced version of the LoZ engine.

Enjoy!

458904.overview: This project is a clone of the TI-99 Wumpus cartridge for the Nintendo NES.  The project has been developed entirely in assembly and has been tested on real hardware.

459314.overview: Take control of Heather the executioner as she carries out the death warrants of our benevolent AND malevolent dictator, Generalissimo Gruntin S. Veizatun. Chop off all prisoners heads in the dungeon to open the door to the next chamber but nothing comes easy so you'll have to go back to reach the exit! Avoid the underpaid possessed suits of armor, diabolical death wheels and gruesome Gruntgoyles that plague Gruntin's Dungeon! There's also spikes...ouch. Look for secret rooms that contain bonus collectables and extra lives!

459366.overview: A hot shooter with 2-minute mode and 5-minute mode is now available! Control Habit who jumps into the 8-bit world and defeat the hordes of enemies!

459801.overview: You have been tasked with defending the most precious resource in the war: Fuel. Wave after wave of enemies will fly in trying to steal our fuel for their own nefarious purposes. Stop the enemy by any means necessary, including sacrificing your ship. If we lose all of our fuel, that's game over for us.

459882.overview: In this action game, the player tries to prevent darkness from extinguishing the central fire. Each time the flame takes damage, the void expands and the size of the visible gameplay area shrinks. Through the use of light orbs and power-ups, the player must not only survive but fight back against hordes of attacking shadows.

460018.overview:
Your friend got hospitalised (it happens), and being a good person, you decided to pay them a visit. However, upon arriving to the Sinai Hill hospital (not as good as the Mount Sinai one just by the street... bloody healthcare...), you soon came to the realisation that something's wrong.

It seems like some of the hospital's patients went mad, and they want you dead! Can you avoid getting mauled by the hospital's weird residents? Can you find your friend and get them out of there? Find out in: FG's RealCast™ Volume 1: Horror Hospital

460808.overview:
A full moon creeps across the autumn sky, with harvests in the fields. At first glance everything seems serene, but it's not. The gates of hell have been cast open and demons now roam the Earth.

Some are pitiful, other vengeful. These are the lost souls, the neglected spirits. After death they were forgotten. No tributes were given, so now they wander the Earth to improve their lot, at the expense of yours!!!

It is a Hungry Ghost Night!

Play as the sexy Sydney Wang or as the hulking Robert Gasse. Travel across the island nation, for the duration of Ghost month. Can you survive the night?

461126.overview:
Hobo Albo is back in this over-the-top action platformer for the NES!

Almost a year has passed since Albo lost his job at Jollibee for “misunderstandings", and after his little… incident terrorizing the good folks of Pembroke Pines at the local swimming pool. Since then, he’s been laying low, doing odd jobs, and spending most of his time using his burner phones to watch YouTube videos. 

But fate doesn’t let a hobo rest for long. On the night of trick-or-treat, an ancient evil force slithers into town. Pumpkins go missing. Candy turns sour. Even the Mayor hasn’t been seen, rumor has it he’s either possessed or passed out in a gutter somewhere. Either way, it’s bad for business.

So, Albo, armed with nothing but street smarts, bad hygiene, and a terrible disguise, sets out on a quest for redemption. He’ll do whatever it takes, even if it means stealing candy straight from kids’ bags or mowing down innocent trick-or-treaters who just happened to be in the wrong cul-de-sac at the wrong time.

461128.overview:
Based on a 100% true story (probably), you’ll step into the crusty shoes of Hobo Albo: once a family man, now a hobo and self-proclaimed "man of leisure" on a mission for the ultimate revenge. After his boss at Jollibee ruined his life and turned him into a walking Florida Man headline, Albo is out to settle the score—and maybe snatch some treasures along the way.

Fight your way through the wild streets of Florida!

    Raccoons fighting you for the last precious blueberry muffin? PULL UP!!.

    Cigarettes and crack pipes? That’s your fuel! (Don’t ask how it works—it’s science.)

    At night, Albo becomes the ultimate peeping tom—taking “window shopping” to disturbing new heights.

But what’s the ultimate goal? Revenge on Jollibee? Nah, too mainstream. Albo’s real dream is to collect enough coins to buy the prize of a lifetime: a Kirby doll. Because even hobos have standards.

Gameplay Features:

    Shopping Cart Mode: When your legs give out or you need to go full nosferatu, hop into your trusty shopping cart to reach high places and keep the chaos rolling.

    Intense muffin fights. Yes, that’s a thing.

   Epic Prison Escape: Get locked up for reasons (probably involving blueberry muffins or public indecency)

    A moral compass? We left that in another game.

More information

462633.overview: Hurdel is an arcade style action game for NES emulators

462640.overview: A new survival platformer game for the NES

462815.overview:
October 31st, 1987: Every fall, folks come to Possum Hollow from miles around for the county fair. Hay rides, hot chocolate and carnival games are on everyone's mind; everyone but Donny and Tami. The past two years they’ve battled an onslaught of evil that’s overrun their beloved town on Halloween night, and they know this year will be no different.

Since learning of the town's curse, they've been researching its dark past and honing their combat skills, preparing for whatever may come. But this year, something feels different, something strange is in the air...

In ‘87 you’ll unleash new skills on the undead - enhanced attacks, exploding pumpkins, wall jumping, broom ride battles, and much more! Do you have what it takes to save Possum Hollow from the sinister forces behind the curse in the year of the witch?

472035.overview: A notorious Chinese bootleg of Tales of Phantasia exists for the NES (Famicom), featuring a heavily downgraded port of the original Super Famicom (SNES) RPG. English-patched versions exist, often using the GBA script, though the game is considered a technical curiosity rather than a faithful port.

478470.overview: An RPG based on based upon Jin Yong's 1961 novel, The Heaven Sword & Dragon Saber.

478569.overview: A backport of the popular PC SRPG The Legend of Fancy Realm. However, unlike the original game, the Nanjing backport is a straight RPG, and not an SRPG.

478926.overview: A board game based on the classic Chinese novel Dream of the Red Chamber.

479536.overview:
This is an unofficial port of Naruto: Path of the Ninja, which was originally released on the Game Boy Advance. 

The game follows the storyline of both the manga and the anime until the end of the Chūnin Exams arc, with Shukaku being the final boss.

Playable characters are Naruto Uzumaki, Sasuke Uchiha, Sakura Haruno, Shikamaru Nara, Neji Hyūga, Rock Lee, and Jiraiya.

479900.overview: A strategy game based on the historical figure Lui Bang, the founder and first emperor of the Han dysnasty. The game's engine is similar to other Nanjing strategy titles.

479904.overview:
The game's title translates to Metalstorm, but it's completely unreleated to Irem's NES game Metal Storm and the mobile game Metalstorm. The title just seems to be a conincedence.

He Jin Feng Bao is an RPG that has the player fighting in a tank. The game was developed by Nice Code Software, and it uses an original battle system that isn't seen in other Nanjing RPGs.

479906.overview: An unofficial backport of the PC game Heroes of Jin Yong. The game is a mashup that combines characters from different novels that were written by Jin Yong. Nanjing's backport is one of its more ambitious titles, and it's considered one of the company's best RPGs.

480937.overview: Backport of Nintendo's SNES strategy game Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War.

481859.overview: A port of Haunted House, originally released on the the Atari 2600, that was featured on the first Atari Flashback console in 2004. Developer Nice Code Software ported the game to the NES because the original Atari Flashback console utilized an "NES-on-a-Chip" architecture.

482550.overview: Bensheng, another Chinese company stole and re-released this game as Zhan Guo Wu Shuang.
